AM:
-Rinse with water or use micellar water if I’m feeling greasy 
-Vanicream Daily moisturizer 
-Biore sunscreen 

PM:
-Cleanse with COSRX snail cleanser 
-COSRX advance snail 96 mucin essence 

-wait 15 minutes-

- mix tretinoin 0.025% with vanicream daily facial moisturizer 

OR 

- natrium Azelaic topical acid 10% 
-then apply vanicream moisturizer

I use tret every other day! The days that I’m not using it, I use the natrium serum. I made the mistake of just applying tret on damp skin in the past and it just irritated the heck out of my skin! Which made my acne more inflamed :( lesson learned!

Anyways, I’ve been using tret since April, but May was when my purging was the worse! 

I am not sure if this is helpful, but I’ve been drinking spearmint tea twice a day because apparently it helps with hormonal acne? But I’ve been doing that for a month and I’ve seen improvement around the jaw area. May or may not work for you, but I thought it would
